## About
BrightSide Painting & Remodeling is a residential painting and repair company based in Woodstock, Georgia. Jon Edens is the owner and estimator, and he's the one you'll talk to about your project.
Jon likes to say homeowners depend on paint to both beautify and protect, so the work starts with preparation. That means fixing rotten wood, checking the surface, whether it's stucco, brick or cedar, and planning around Georgia weather before a brush comes out.
Every project is supervised and ends with a final walkthrough with you. Neighbors have given BrightSide a 5 rating on Google from 76 reviews.

## Services
- Interior Painting: Walls, ceilings and trim inside your home. One customer had their new house painted and some drywall texture removed from the ceilings before moving in.
- Exterior Painting: Exterior repainting planned around Georgia's weather and your home's surfaces, paired with color guidance when you want it.
- Deck Staining & Painting: Staining or painting your deck so it looks good and holds up outside.
- Interior & Exterior Repairs: Carpentry repair, including rotten wood and trim, so the paint goes onto a sound surface.
- Complimentary Color Consultation: You have the option of meeting with a Sherwin-Williams color consultant at your home to pick colors and products that fit your taste and budget.
- Complimentary Estimates: Jon will come out, look at the project and give you an estimate at no charge.

## FAQ
Q: Do you charge for an estimate?
A: No. The initial consultation and the project estimate are free of charge. You can call or schedule your estimate online.

Q: How does the color consultation work?
A: It begins with a 90-minute in-home visit from a professionally trained Sherwin-Williams Personal Color Consultant, who helps you settle on colors and products for your style and budget.

Q: Do you supply the paint?
A: One customer said the crew provided all of the paint and stain from Sherwin Williams, and all they had to do was choose the colors.

Q: Do you work with real estate agents?
A: Yes. Georgia real estate agents and their clients referred to BrightSide qualify for a 10% discount and get priority scheduling for estimates and project work.
